podcast.body: This band benefited from promotion on active rock radio stations in the 2010s. "We can also include breaking Benjamin, shine down, avenge 7 fold, five-finger death punch, disturbed tool system of the down and of course Metallica."

podcast.title: Phobias and Health Issues
podcast.body: Benjamin Burnley suffers from several severe phobias, most notably a "terrible terrible fear of flying" that has significantly prevented Breaking Benjamin from touring internationally, limiting them to the US and Canada where bus travel is feasible. He also contends with hypochondria and nyctophobia (fear of the dark). A recovering alcoholic, his drinking issues were further complicated by Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome, a condition that can impair eyesight, memory, emotional state, and balance. "He has a terrible terrible fear of flying, something that has held the band back from touring internationally."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
